$comment: ALDC factory crew (6.0.0). Each role runs as its own subsession through a host adapter (tools/factory/hosts/<host>.js). agent maps the role to that host's agent; null runs a plain prompt. budget is USD per call, timeoutMin minutes per call. caps bound the whole run. verify and test are shell commands run from the project root (null = not-run); certified is the certified BCQuality review command ({base} is replaced by the integration base commit).
